动作(中): 镜头缓慢横移，扫过空无一人的香港老式窄巷夜街。一辆破旧红色出租车停在路边昏黄路灯下。两侧老居民楼晾衣杆林立。湿漉漉的沥青路面反射着灯光。空无一人，安静而等待的氛围。
动作(英): [Shot 1] A slow lateral pan across the empty Hong Kong old narrow night street. A worn old red taxi is parked at the roadside under a dim yellow street lamp. Old residential buildings with clothes-drying poles line both sides. The wet asphalt reflects the lamp light. No people. Quiet, waiting atmosphere.
音效(中): 安静的夜街环境音：远处的车流声、出租车怠速低鸣、夜风
音效(英): quiet night street ambience: distant traffic, faint taxi engine idle, night breeze
音乐(中): 舒缓缓慢的钢琴旋律，稀疏而怅然，90 年代港式爱情片风格
音乐(英): a soft slow piano melody, sparse and wistful, 90s Hong Kong romance film style

动作(中): 中景：穿白色背心的青年站在街角（夜间），望着红色出租车方向，犹豫不舍，双手垂在身侧。昏黄的暖色路灯落在他脸上。忧郁氛围，他没有说话。
动作(英): [Shot 1] A medium shot of [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, standing at the street corner of [Subject 2] at night. He watches in the direction of the red taxi, hesitant and reluctant, hands hanging at his sides. Dim warm streetlight falls on his face. Melancholic mood. He does not speak.
音效(中): 夜街环境音：远处车流声，微风
音效(英): night street ambience: distant traffic, faint breeze
音乐(中): 轻柔缓慢的钢琴旋律，温和而怅然
音乐(英): a soft slow piano melody, gentle and wistful

动作(中): 年轻女子坐在路边红色出租车的后座，微微转头望向车窗，安静而悲伤。车头灯亮着，窗外可见夜街。她没有说话。
动作(英): [Shot 1] [Subject 1], the young woman, sits in the back seat of the old red taxi at the roadside of [Subject 2]. She turns her head slightly toward the window, quiet and sad. The taxi headlights are on. Night street visible through the window. She does not speak.
音效(中): 汽车发动声，低沉的引擎嗡鸣，夜街环境音
音效(英): car engine starting, low hum, night street ambience
音乐(中): 轻柔缓慢的钢琴旋律，忧郁
音乐(英): a soft slow piano melody, melancholy

动作(中): 侧向跟拍：穿白色背心的青年沿街奔跑，追着驶离的红色出租车。神情焦急而绝望，脚下踉跄了一下但继续跑。夜街路灯从身边掠过。他还没说话。
动作(英): [Shot 1] A lateral tracking shot: [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, runs along [Subject 2], chasing after the red taxi which is driving away. His expression is anxious and desperate. He stumbles slightly but keeps running. Night street lamps blur past. He does not speak yet.
音效(中): 人行道上奔跑的脚步声，远处车流，喘息声
音效(英): footsteps running on pavement, distant traffic, breath

动作(中): 特写：穿白色背心的青年站在夜街上，面朝出租车离去的方向，深吸一口气，带着坚定而含泪的表情大声喊出。
动作(英): [Shot 1] A close-up of [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, standing on the night street of [Subject 2], facing the direction of the departing taxi. He takes a breath and shouts loudly with a determined, tearful expression.
音效(中): 他的喊声（男主角），远处车流，夜风
音效(英): his shouting voice (S1), distant traffic, night breeze
音乐(中): 缓慢钢琴，情绪涌动而心酸

动作(中): 出租车内：年轻女子回头望向车窗，眼眶含泪，双唇微抿。窗外的夜街在玻璃上模糊成光斑。她没有说话，深受触动，沉默无言。
动作(英): [Shot 1] Inside the taxi: [Subject 1], the young woman, turns her head back toward the rear window, eyes brimming with tears, lips slightly pressed. The night street of [Subject 2] blurs behind the glass. She does not speak. Deeply touched, silent.
音效(中): 微弱的汽车引擎声，安静的夜晚环境音
音效(英): faint car engine, quiet night ambience
音乐(中): 轻柔缓慢的钢琴，温柔而动人
音乐(英): soft slow piano, tender and moving
